---
title: "Quality of life — primary estimand"
subtitle: "Pooled treatment odds for a worse six-month outcome"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Two hundred deterministically selected posterior treatment draws are retained
from every imputation. Equal numbers of draws give every completed dataset equal
weight. The proportional-odds ratio is the odds of being in a worse category
(including death) under intervention versus control; values below one favour
intervention.

```{r}
#| label: derive-primary-qol-estimand
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
model_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "models")
estimand_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "estimand")
result_dir <- here::here("results", "primary", "quality-of-life")
dir.create(estimand_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (index in seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)) {
  draw_path <- file.path(estimand_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!force && file.exists(draw_path)) next

  model <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))
  draws <- as.data.frame(model$draws)
  if (!"tx" %in% names(draws)) {
    stop("The QoL model posterior does not contain the treatment coefficient `tx`.")
  }
  set.seed(analysis_seed(config, "qol", index, offset = 400L))
  selected <- sample.int(
    nrow(draws),
    size = config$markov$post_estimation_draws,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  estimand <- data.frame(
    imputation = index,
    draw = seq_len(config$markov$post_estimation_draws),
    log_odds_ratio_worse = draws$tx[selected],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  estimand$odds_ratio_worse <- exp(estimand$log_odds_ratio_worse)
  arrow::write_parquet(estimand, draw_path, compression = "zstd")
}

draws <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(config$imputation$main$m), function(index) {
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  )) |>
    as.data.frame()
}))
rownames(draws) <- NULL

summary <- data.frame(
  estimand = "proportional odds ratio for a worse six-month QoL/death state",
  posterior_mean = mean(draws$odds_ratio_worse),
  posterior_median = median(draws$odds_ratio_worse),
  q025 = quantile(draws$odds_ratio_worse, 0.025, names = FALSE),
  q975 = quantile(draws$odds_ratio_worse, 0.975, names = FALSE),
  probability_benefit = mean(draws$log_odds_ratio_worse < 0),
  imputations = config$imputation$main$m,
  posterior_draws_per_imputation = config$markov$post_estimation_draws,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

arrow::write_parquet(
  draws,
  file.path(result_dir, "estimand-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
writeLines(
  yaml::as.yaml(list(
    status = "available",
    reason = "The prespecified OS rule selected the adjusted death-inclusive ordinal QoL analysis.",
    artifacts = c(
      "results/primary/quality-of-life/summary.parquet",
      "results/primary/quality-of-life/estimand-draws.parquet"
    )
  )),
  file.path(result_dir, "status.yml")
)
```
